body:
# Moss giants (Wilderness)

Moss giants have only Defence level 30 and 60 Hitpoints, so any decent melee weapon dispatches them quickly. Krystilia assigns them as a Wilderness task, so kills must occur in the Wilderness. They carry a 50% Fire weakness; fire spells are fastest, but melee with cheap, expendable gear is usually preferred to limit the risk of losing valuables to PKers.
